verdict.rationale: Kong, as evidenced here, is an API gateway and management platform (gateway, AI Gateway, Konnect, decK, Dev Portal, Catalog). Running a request collection as a test suite with a pass/fail report is an API-client capability, outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows collections or a test runner; the Dev Portal's 'try API operations' is interactive exploration, not automated suite execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an entire collection as an automated test suite with a pass/fail report
